instruction: Create wordcount.py with a function count_words(text) that returns the number of whitespace-separated words, and a test_wordcount.py with pytest-style test functions covering a normal case and an empty string. Run the tests to confirm they pass.

grader.script: python3 -c "from wordcount import count_words; assert count_words('a b c')==3; assert count_words('')==0" && python3 -m pytest test_wordcount.py -q 2>/dev/null || python3 test_wordcount.py 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import test_wordcount"
